description: Full-text search across the articles in force of the French codes (DILA LEGI consolidated text) — find which article of French law deals with a subject, in French: "responsabilité du fait des choses", "licenciement pour motif économique", "abus de biens sociaux". Optional `code` restricts to one code. Returns ranked articles with code, number, section path and an excerpt; quote a phrase for an exact phrase match.

code.description: Optional — restrict to one code. The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: only articles in force on that date (default today).

query.description: Words or a "quoted phrase", in French. Accents optional.

name: fr_legi_search
title: Fr Legi Search
